fusions.name: Sky-Blotting Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 5 flights of locusts at once, spread apart, out to 8 tiles, each dealing 9 damage. They ignore armour, and 15% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Breeding Quiver
fusions.desc: Shoots a locust at a target up to 7 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Closer Horizon
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Splitting Shaft
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 9 lightning damage, then leaps to 2 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 6 seconds.
